meta.name: webgpt-todo-response
meta.description: Use after receiving WebGPT or another LLM review on a Formax todo and before sending the todo back for another pass. Produce a concise handoff response that says what we adopted, what we reject or question, and what the reviewer should specifically re-evaluate in `docs/todolist.md`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码审查反馈并生成交接回复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在收到代码审查后快速整理采纳与拒绝意见并回复。
copy.tagline_en: Organize code review feedback and generate handoff responses
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly summarize adopted and rejected feedback after a code review.

howto.what: 收到 WebGPT 或其他 LLM 对 Formax 待办事项的审查后，Claude 会在将待办发回再审前，生成一份简洁的交接回复，说明采纳了什么、拒绝了什么或有何疑问，并指出评审员应重新评估的具体内容。
howto.when: 当用户收到 WebGPT 审查结果，要求准备待办事项的下一步审核回复时触发；例如用户询问是否有反驳意见、要求生成回复请 WebGPT 评估待办，或对比建议与实现范围。

say.text: 请生成一份回复给 WebGPT，列出我们采纳和拒绝的点。
为待办事项准备反馈，重点指出需要重新评估的部分。
say.note: Claude 会聚焦高价值复核点。

say.text: 对比 WebGPT 的建议，生成一份交接回复。
say.note: Claude 会检查待办是否偏离边界。

howto.what_en: After receiving a WebGPT or other LLM review on a Formax todo, before sending the todo back for another pass, Claude produces a concise handoff response: what was adopted, rejected, or questioned, and what the reviewer should specifically re-evaluate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a response to WebGPT's review of a Formax todo, e.g., asking for rebuttals, preparing a handoff with evaluation requests, or comparing recommendations against scope.

say_en.text: Prepare a reply for WebGPT listing what we adopted and rejected.
say_en.note: Claude will output a draft response.

say_en.text: Create feedback for the todo, highlighting points to re-evaluate.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on high-value review points.

say_en.text: Compare WebGPT's suggestions and produce a handoff response.
say_en.note: Claude will check for scope drift.
